vid_urls.title: GO! - SpaceX - Falcon 9 - Starlink 15-18 - SLC-4E - Vandenberg SFB, CA - Space Affairs Live
vid_urls.description:
Launch Date: October 30, 2026 (PDT)
Launch Time:  8:48 p.m. PDT (October 31, 0348 UTC, 04:48 CET) 
Launch Window: Open until October 31, 12:48 a.m. PDT 
Launch Site: SLC-4E - Vandenberg Space Force Base, California
Targeted Orbit: Low Earth Orbit (LEO)
Launch Inclination: Southeast
Launch Status: Scheduled and announced 

Mission: Starlink Group 15-18
Launch Provider: SpaceX
Launcher System: Falcon 9 (Booster 1093 - Turnaround time 38 days)
Flight for the Booster: 7
Previous Flights of the Booster: 6 - NROL-179, SDA-T1TL-E, SDA-T1TL-A and three Starlink missions
Droneship: Of Course I Still Love You (OCISLY)

Price: $74 million (without payload)
Diameter: 3,7 m
Height: 70 meters
Payload to Orbit: 22,800 LEO / 8,300 GTO
Lift-Off Thrust: 7,607 kilonewtons
Fairing: Diameter 5,2 meters / ...
